floor.regime: target-disjoint (GroupKFold-10 by target, trained only within the 285)

ProteinBias.features: 20 amino-acid residue counts of the 16 A pocket + total

floor.note: Durant et al. (Bioinformatics 41(2) btaf040) report that bias-only baselines reach state-of-the-art on CASF-2016 when trained on PDBbind General (~19k complexes), i.e. in the target-OVERLAPPING regime. The floor therefore depends on the split, not on the model.

ceiling.why_not_0.964: 20.1% of matched BindingDB Ki/Kd records sit within 0.02 log units of the PDBbind label - the same primary measurement, not an independent one

findings: Vina (0.502) and Vinardo (0.428) both fall below BothBias (0.534), a model that never sees the protein-ligand interaction.
LigandBias with 205 descriptors (0.502) is no better than the earlier 14-descriptor null (0.547) - the floor is set by the split, not the feature count.
ProteinBias alone is 0.241 under a target-disjoint split, versus near state-of-the-art in the literature's target-overlapping split: the gap IS the memorisation of target identity.
RF-Score v1/v2 (0.713/0.741) clear the target-disjoint floor but were trained on PDBbind refined, which overlaps CASF targets, so they belong to the overlapping regime where the floor is far higher.

split_effect.design: identical 285 complexes, identical features, identical RandomForest; only the CV split changes
split_effect.interpretation: ProteinBias more than doubles purely from seeing the same target in training - pocket composition acts as a target lookup key, not a physical descriptor. Usable band shrinks from 0.35 (target unseen) to 0.20 (target seen), and shrinks further in the literature regime where bias-only baselines train on ~19k complexes.

data_path.pdbbind_general_labels: NOT OBTAINABLE - www.pdbbind-cn.org and its Aliyun mirror are off the allowlist, Zenodo and Hugging Face are off the allowlist
data_path.toolboxsf: github.com/guydurant/toolboxsf is reachable but ships only code and a 19,078-line PDB code list, no labels and no structures; it has NO LICENSE file
data_path.rcsb_substitute: insufficient - in a random sample of 24 PDBbind codes RCSB carried a binding-affinity annotation for 9 (37.5%) and Ki/Kd for only 2 (8.3%), though ligand SMILES reached 92% and UniProt 100%; RCSB affinity provenance is itself BindingDB
data_path.feasible_alternative: train LigandBias on the 258,749 BindingDB Ki/Kd/IC50 records already on disk (184,762 molecules over 65 of the 78 CASF targets, excluding the 210 matched CASF molecules) - ligand-only features need no structures, so this reproduces the external-training target-overlapping regime

external_floor.source: BindingDB Ki/Kd, 44,754 (target, molecule) pairs over 58 targets, CASF molecules excluded
external_floor.features: ligand-only RDKit 2D descriptors (200 usable after dropping Ipc and non-finite columns)
external_floor.interpretation: Seeing the target in training is worth about three times a 175-fold increase in training ligands (256 -> 44,754). The floor is set by what the split allows the model to memorise, not by how much data it has.
